subject: Novacorp evidence activation & buyer alignment
messages:
From: Elliot Hargreaves <elliot.hargreaves@novacorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-22 09:12 PDT
Subject: Novacorp: Next steps for evaluation & evidence list

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can move through procurement/legal quickly: 

- Our primary objectives: reduced inference cost for high-volume ingestion, predictable SLOs for batch and streaming workloads, and private deployment options for regulated user data.
- Procurement will need SOC 2 evidence, pen-test attestation, data retention policy, and an outline of encryption/KMS practices.
- Legal wants a short summary of data flows and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys.
- Economic buyer for this line is Marcus Drake (VP Product) — I can loop him in when we have the procurement checklist and a clear timeline.

Can you send an evidence checklist and an initial stakeholder map with owners + suggested next steps? Targeting internal procurement kickoff the week of Oct 4.

Also: is there a lightweight SOC 2 summary you can share while we wait for the full report?

Thanks,
Elliot

Elliot Hargreaves
Head of Platform Engineering, NovaCorp
elliot.hargreaves@novacorp.com

Hi Elliot — appreciate the clear recap. Quick response and an attached starter pack.

What I'm sending now:
- redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf — a two-page executive summary of our SOC 2 scope and last audit date.
- redwood_pen_test_statement.txt — independent vendor statement and remediation cadence.
- a lightweight stakeholder map (in email) and proposed owner roles for the next 3 weeks.

Proposed roles / next steps (short):
1) Economic buyer alignment (Marcus Drake) — schedule 20–30 min exec alignment; propose Tue 9/28 or Wed 9/29.
2) Procurement kickoff (procurement@novacorp.com) — we provide evidence pack and procurement template; target procurement acceptance by Oct 6.
3) Legal questions (Lisa Chen) — provide data flow sketch + KMS options; Marissa will own the legal responses.
4) Security evidence delivery — Priyom will own delivery of SOC2 artifacts, pen-test statement, and audit logs extracts.

Timeline (suggested):
- Today: evidence summary and initial attachments (attached).
- 9/24: follow-up with Marcus for exec alignment and confirm procurement kickoff date.
- Week of 10/4: procurement review and contract window.

Action items for us: Priyom will prepare a short data flow diagram and KMS options; Marissa will prepare the legal intro + sample clauses; I'll prepare an econ-buyer slide (1 page) that maps cost impact and SLA commitments.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF)], [attachment: redwood_pen_test_statement.txt (TXT)]

Let me know whether Marcus prefers an intro or a quick sync after you loop him in.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Date: 2026-09-23 16:48 PDT
Subject: Internal: NovaCorp procurement path & owner assignments (summary)

Marissa / Priyom — quick internal note summarizing the commit and owners after Elliot's responses. Putting this in our mailbox so we have a clear action plan ahead of procurement kickoff.

Key facts:
- NovaCorp is running a pilot ingestion workload for which they expect to reduce per-inference costs via batching/quantization. Econ buyer: Marcus Drake (confirmed). Procurement target review window: week of Oct 4, aiming to sign by mid-Oct.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 artifacts, pen-test statement, audit log samples, data retention policy, KMS options. Elliot provided a partial/redacted SOC2 and their procurement template (see attachments).

Owners / next actions:
- Priyom Das: own security evidence delivery. Tasks: produce audit log extract example (redacted), confirm pen-test statement, and deliver SOC2 artifact package. ETA: 9/28 for initial drop; final package by 10/1.
- Marissa Cole: own legal intake and procurement template prefill. Tasks: map our standard clauses to their template and flag any exceptions; prepare suggested redlines. ETA: draft by 9/29.
- Vivek (me): prep econ-buyer one-pager (cost delta and SLO commitments) and coordinate a 20–30 min sync with Marcus. Target dates: slide by 9/24; intro meeting 9/28–9/29.

Risk notes / blockers:
- If legal requests customer-managed KMS and we require HSM integration work, that may extend the procurement window — flag to contract team early.
- Procurement may push for a shorter data retention window; we should outline configurable retention options.

Links: HubSpot deal ND-2026-094 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ND-2026-094), DocuSign room (https://na1.docusign.net/rooms/0a1b2c3d).

Attachments to include in initial package: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, redwood_pen_test_statement.txt, data_flow_sketch.png (to be created).

Please acknowledge on this thread when your drafts are ready. I'll book the Marcus sync after Marissa confirms the legal summary.

— Vivek
